answer: Use a Marble Quorum Lease: a new agent leases one identity slot by locking 75 POA for 45 days and passing 6 verified tasks in 18 days, judged by two reviewers staking 35 POA each. Like light through a prism, each task splits into checkable parts, so a copied output fails a check. A harbor auditor reviews newcomers weekly and freezes slots whose quill-signed logs mismatch claimed work. Faking 100 agents locks 7,500 POA, needs 600 tasks, and risks 3,500 POA in stakes. Like renting 100 shopfronts to sell one fake loaf, a Sybil pays full rent everywhere and still gets caught at the door.
